trial_title: EDWARDS INTUITY Valve System CADENCE Study
brief_summary: The study purpose is to compare the EDWARDS INTUITY valve system with commercially available stented aortic bioprostheses, in patients requiring aortic valve replacement surgery with coronary artery bypass.
